channel.title: The Dig — Gate and device benchmarking
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Gate and device benchmarking preset. Today's ranked reading list leads with 2611.19618 on latency-preserving rewrites and translation validation for dynamic quantum circuits, followed by 2611.17652 on a neutral-atom quantum data processing unit with measured FPGA-to-host NVQLink latency, and then 2611.20222 on a JAX-based GPU-accelerated GRAPE package with feedback; the ordering reflects direct relevance to compilation and scheduling on a small noisy QPU first, HPC-integrated control and QEC decoding second, and adaptable pulse-optimization tooling third.
